description:
Valeo is a tech global company, designing breakthrough solutions to reinvent the mobility. We are an automotive supplier partner to automakers and new mobility actors worldwide. Our vision? Invent a greener and more secured mobility, thanks to solutions focusing on intuitive driving and reducing CO2 emissions. We are leader on our businesses, and recognized as one of the largest global innovative companies. 
 
 Ready to tackle the challenges of the vehicle of the future? Join us and lead tech innovation for a reinvented interior experience! 
   
 What you will win: 
 As part of a global community of talented people, you will grow and thrive working on advanced technologies for greener, safer and smarter mobility. Our company culture gives all our employees the opportunity every day to #Dare.Care.Share.  You will receive a best in class, total compensation package that provides a comprehensive benefits program with real financial value 

 About the Role: 
 As a Software Engineer. you will be responsible for: 

 Depending on their  scope, the incumbent will be in charge of one the domain : 
 Budget 
 Budget Commitment : Demonstrate commitment to achieving project budgets by optimizing resource allocation and adhering to cost-effective engineering practices. 
 Support operations: 
 Lead Complex Projects : Lead the technical execution of engineering projects, particularly those involving Newness levels 2-3 (new designs based on existing knowledge or design based on existing rules). 
 Technical Problem Solving : Serve as a referent for critical problem solving within the Discipline, utilizing Valeo standard methodologies like QRQC (Quick Response Quality Control) to identify root causes and implement effective solutions. 
 Customer Communication : Effectively communicate complex technical solutions and challenges to internal and external customers, ensuring clarity and understanding. 
 Technical Transversal Sharing : Proactively share technical knowledge and best practices across teams and divisions, fostering collaboration and knowledge dissemination. 
 Competencies: 
 Technical Coaching and Mentoring : Provide technical guidance and mentorship to Discipline Engineers, fostering their professional development and expertise. 
 Design Standards Development : Leverage expertise to build, improve, and validate design standards for Newness levels 2-3, ensuring alignment with industry best practices and Valeo's strategic objectives. 
 Efficiency: 
 Digitalization Roadmap Execution : Actively participate in the execution of the Discipline's Digitalization Roadmap, identifying and implementing opportunities for process improvement and automation. 
 Continuous Improvement : Analyze problem-solving outcomes to identify systemic issues and propose improvements to existing processes and methodologies. 
 Innovation: 
 Innovative Solution Development : Propose and contribute to the development of innovative solutions to engineering challenges, leveraging existing technologies and methodologies. 
 Intellectual Property Protection : Identify patentable inventions arising from innovative solutions and actively participate in the patent filing process (IP). 
 Collaboration and Influence: 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration : Collaborate effectively with engineers and stakeholders from other Disciplines to ensure seamless project execution and integrated solutions. 
 
 What You Should Have: 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or Controls Engineering 
 5+ years’ experience as embedded software Engineer,  Electrical Engineer, or related occupation  
 Demonstrated excellence in C programming skills in the embedded context 
 A proven track record of developing and delivering AUTOSAR compliant software for embedded devices or controllers using configuration tools like EB Tresos, DaVinci Configurator, DaVinci Developer etc 
 Experience with real-time operating systems, micro-controllers and their standard peripheral components 
 Hands on knowledge of AUTOSAR Classic on various layers - MCAL/BSW/CDD/RTE/Applications etc 
 Experience in working on Aurix, and Renesas or any other advanced micro controllers. 
 knowledge of automotive diagnostics - UDS, DoIP, etc 
 Experience in reading schematics and data sheets 
 Experience in debugging of low-level embedded projects - Lauterbach, iSystem etc 
 Knowledge of automotive vehicle communication networks, such as CAN, CAN-FD, Ethernet, LIN and its simulation tools (Vector CANoe & CANalyzer) 
 Experience with scripting tools and methods to optimize SW development and testing activities 
 Experience with testing techniques, e.g. unit, HIL, SIL testing 
 Experience in Functional Safety (FuSa) and ISO 26262 
 Knowledge of MISRA C/C++ rules and automotive SPICE 
 knowledge of ASPICE, V-Model, functional safety topics 
 Join us! 
 Thanks to its strategy focused on innovation, Valeo aims at reducing CO² emissions and developing intuitive driving to propose greener, safer, and smarter mobility.  The fantastic (r)evolution towards the vehicle of the future provides amazing career opportunities and challenging jobs! 
   
 Diversity by nature
 At Valeo, innovation is driven by the diversity, authenticity and energy of its talents. You are looking for new technological and human adventures? Join Valeo and its more than 100.000 employees across the globe! More information about valeo : https://www.valeo.com
